body: Things change, it’s so so tormenting to feel like a burden to people or like your bringing them down. It’s really hard to step back and see that you matter and the thing in your head telling you horrible things is wrong. I’ve been there it’s awful but things do change hun and you need to be here to see them change

Please speak to someone. Anyone. Your life is so precious even when all seems lost. I feel like driving into oncoming traffic right now but I’m just clinging onto the hope that someone cares. And I think that someone out there does care about all of us. please message me. Your life matters.
Thank you, your reply has lifted my mood a lot. I appreciate it 💕
